Where we went, who we went with, and what happened. Each story is written from the team’s own photographs and notes.

Cotonou, Benin · Easter 2026

Easter in Cotonou

Over Easter 2026, The Tree of LIF joined Église de la Paix du Christ for a multi-day hospital outreach in Cotonou. Volunteers visited patients ward by ward, prayed with them, and helped families with medical bills.
